items.title: Overview
items.content: Get a birds-eye view of your creative project, from milestones to current progress. Keep your vision clear and your team aligned with real-time updates.

items.title: Roadmap
items.content: Plan your future trajectory with a visual roadmap of upcoming features and releases. Track your long-term goals and stay ahead of the curve.

items.title: Backlog
items.content: Manage your pending tasks and ideas. Prioritize what matters most and ensure nothing falls through the cracks as your project grows.

items.framework: Actual React function component with useState/useRef/useLayoutEffect, keyed JSX and normal React props/ref lifecycle; no native DOM mount wrapper.

stateContract.controlled: value/open !== undefined. Props are authoritative. undefined releases control, preserving last effective state.
stateContract.callback: Synchronous request; exact false vetoes an internal uncontrolled proposal; controlled owner props remain authoritative even if callback returns false. Async return is not awaited.
stateContract.commit: Internal proposal is finalized in layout after the parent commit; current restrictions and owner revision are rechecked. Ordinary metadata preserves the proposal.
stateContract.lifecycle: Actual unmount, keyed replacement, changed controlled owner or newer request invalidates stale internal proposal. No legacy mutable getState/update API.

items.style: Scoped .fr7.fr7-disclosure; inherited shared tokens. Follow square geometry, wrapping full text and explicit surface/ink/accent pairings replace source rounded/blur/animation styling. Other Provider token themes are not independent ID acceptance.
items.form: No editable inputs. All buttons type=button. External form.reset does not change React state or text. No fabricated business submission. Editable-field/native-value reset and composition are N/A; keyboard composition guards remain applicable.

verification.sourceIdentity: Seven exact saved source/primitive Git blobs independently recomputed against fixed upstream tree.

sourceStructure: Three tabs overview/roadmap/backlog, default overview, horizontal automatic activation.
Each paragraph preserves one emphasized phrase.
Track + paper selected tab + three associated panel elements, only selected panel visible.

props.items: Readonly text-only DisclosureItem[]. Missing/null content selects before/emphasis/after; explicit undefined/empty string selects empty prose.
props.value: string|null; invalid/removed/disabled item normalizes to first enabled item, empty/all disabled => null.
props.disabled: Native disabled tab buttons; current panel remains readable.
props.label: 创意项目 by default.

nativeApi.publicStateRead: Read controlled value in parent or selected tab/panel ARIA state; no mutable imperative getState.

keyboard: ArrowLeft/Right wrap enabled controls; RTL changes direction.
Home/End select edges. Automatic focus (native/programmatic/arrow) requests once while target owns focus; manual activation uses Enter/Space.
Preserve defaultPrevented, isComposing/nativeEvent.isComposing, keyCode/nativeEvent.keyCode229 and alt/ctrl/meta/shift.
No Tab interception. External focus taken during focus/selection callbacks is not reclaimed.
enhancements: Controlled/uncontrolled request API, exact-false veto, dynamic text items and item/global disabled.
Idempotent normalization preserves structured prose on items round trip.
Keyed React controls retain captured span nodes on metadata and same-owner changes.
Source hidden panels retain associated React DOM nodes rather than source library mount/animation lifecycle.

items.title: How secure is my data?
items.content: We use industry-standard encryption and secure infrastructure to protect your data at every step. Your information is never shared without your consent.

items.title: How do transactions work?
items.content: Transactions are processed instantly and reflected in your account in real time. You can view detailed history and insights anytime.

items.title: Can I manage everything in one place?
items.content: Yes - track activity, manage settings, and control your account from a single, unified dashboard designed for clarity and speed.

Leading ChevronDown/Up from exact primitive; continuous separators and indented content.

props.items: Readonly text-only DisclosureItem[] with stable string values.
props.value: readonly string[]; effective selection is current source-order intersection, including already-open disabled items.
props.disabled: Native disabled triggers; open panels stay readable. Disabled items cannot toggle.
props.label: 常见问题 by default.

nativeApi.publicStateRead: Read controlled value in parent or trigger aria-expanded; no mutable imperative getState.

keyboard: ArrowUp/Down/Home/End only move enabled trigger focus without changing expanded values.
Enter/Space toggle; repeat ignored for toggle.
Prior prevented events, IME229 and modifiers are untouched. Tab stays native.
enhancements: Multiple-only API deliberately retains source semantics, not a generic single/multiple template.
Dynamic items/disabled/request API are explicit extensions. Current disabled target is revalidated after parent callback for both opening and closing.
Leading SVG/path nodes remain stable under metadata and expansion; only path d changes.
Panels keep keyed hidden DOM; source library animation/unmount internals are not replicated.

verification.sourceIdentity: Seven exact saved source/primitive Git blobs independently recomputed against fixed upstream tree.

sourceStructure: AlertDialog trigger, title, irreversible account deletion description, Cancel/Continue; starts closed.
No X; outside pointer does not dismiss; Continue has no source backend implementation.
Source primitive is Radix portal modal. Adapter uses native HTMLDialogElement showModal/close in same React tree with alertdialog role.

props.triggerRef: Ref to the single actual trigger, including React19 callback-ref cleanup.
props.disabled: Blocks opening and confirmation; Cancel/Escape remain reachable while open.
props.title: 你确定要继续吗？
props.description: Faithful Chinese source irreversible account/data deletion description, with separate visible local-only disclaimer.
props.onConfirm: Local callback, exact false vetoes; no deletion/network operation.
props.onCancel: Local Cancel action callback, exact false vetoes. Native Escape uses open-change reason escape.
props.onNativeError: Reports missing showModal/close or repeated rejected native close; no silent nonmodal fallback.
props.onKeyDownCapture: Native keyboard interception can be handled by caller; no custom Tab loop.

nativeApi.publicStateRead: Read controlled open or native dialog.open/trigger aria-expanded; no mutable imperative getState.

focusLifecycle: Native showModal provides modality; Cancel carries native autofocus.
Metadata updates retain the live dialog/action nodes and do not call focus again.
Native cancel prevents default while owner request resolves; no outside-pointer dismissal.
Unexpected native close can recover once after refusal; repeated refusal yields visible error rather than an unbounded focus/close cycle.
Closing/unmount closes native node. Connected trigger is restored only while focus remains owned and no other open native dialog owns the layer. Explicit current outside focus is preserved.
showModal focus callbacks may update/close/unmount/rekey; actual live operation/node identity is checked. Native focus, background business inertness and browser chrome behavior remain browser gates.
enhancements: Single native button removes source nested-button structure.
Native dialog replaces Radix portal internals; same-tree token inheritance avoids copying Provider values into a portal.
Controlled request/ref/error callbacks are explicit adapter extensions.
Visible local-only boundary states that Continue does not delete accounts or send data. No account operation is implemented.
